completion.title: Complete environment variables in code
completion.description: Complete known environment keys in supported code references; .env file completion remains enabled.

showValues.title: Show each key's value in completion and hover
showValues.description: Show values in completion and hover. Keys containing PASS, SECRET, TOKEN, KEY or CREDENTIAL are masked; run .env: Show Value at Caret to reveal one.

checkKeyNames.title: Check key names
checkKeyNames.description: Warn about keys with '-', lowercase letters or a wrong first character.

checkDuplicateKeys.title: Warn about duplicate keys
checkDuplicateKeys.description: Warn when a key is declared more than once in a file.

checkFormatting.title: Check spacing and blank lines
checkFormatting.description: Warn about spaces around '=', trailing whitespace and extra blank lines.

checkValueQuotes.title: Check value quotes
checkValueQuotes.description: Warn about unquoted values with spaces and ${…} values outside double quotes.

checkVariableReferences.title: Check ${…} references
checkVariableReferences.description: Warn about empty ${} and variables declared in no .env, Dockerfile or compose file.
